assertions.description: AudioContext is exposed on the global — the surface that gains the renderSizeHint option.
OfflineAudioContext is exposed — its options dictionary also gains renderSizeHint.

new AudioContext({renderSizeHint: 128}) must not throw on ANY conformant browser: post-ship 128 is a valid hint; pre-ship WebIDL requires unknown dictionary members to be ignored. A throw fails this on both kinds of browser.
new AudioContext({renderSizeHint: 'default'}) must not throw — 'default' is a valid AudioContextRenderSizeCategory post-ship and an ignored unknown member pre-ship.
new AudioContext({renderSizeHint: 'hardware'}) must not throw — 'hardware' is a valid AudioContextRenderSizeCategory post-ship and an ignored unknown member pre-ship.

BaseAudioContext.prototype exposes the renderQuantumSize attribute — the readable counterpart to renderSizeHint. A fail here is the honest 'this browser has not shipped the feature yet' answer (anticipated Chrome 153).

A freshly-constructed AudioContext with no options reports renderQuantumSize === 128 frames per spec. Fails on a browser that has not shipped the attribute (honest not-yet) and on one that shipped it with a wrong default.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const Ctx=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!Ctx)return false;const c=new Ctx();const ok=c.renderQuantumSize===128;try{await c.close();}catch(_){};return ok;})()

assertions.description: With renderSizeHint: 'hardware', renderQuantumSize is a positive integer chosen by the UA. Fails where the attribute has not shipped (honest not-yet).
assertions.test: (async()=>{const Ctx=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!Ctx)return false;let c;try{c=new Ctx({renderSizeHint:'hardware'});}catch(e){return false;}const q=c.renderQuantumSize;try{await c.close();}catch(_){};return Number.isInteger(q)&&q>0;})()

assertions.description: OfflineAudioContext constructed with renderSizeHint: 256 reports a positive-integer renderQuantumSize (the UA may round the requested value). Fails where the attribute has not shipped (honest not-yet).
